title: Shorthair · the close-coated breeds
blurb: The classic short coat, from the British cobbiness to the Russian Blue's silver tipping: dense, easy to keep and the base of most modern breeds.

items.d: Round, dense-coated and calm; Britain's native shorthair and one of the oldest recognised breeds.
The working cat of the American farm and ship, standardised as a sturdy, even-tempered shorthair.
A Persian with a short plush coat: the flat face without the daily grooming.
The blue-grey French cat of the monasteries, quiet, stocky and famously a good mouser.
Silver-tipped blue coat, green eyes and a reserved manner; said to have come from Arkhangelsk.
Thailand's silver-blue cat, with a heart-shaped face and a copper-green eye.
The brown cat of Burma, 3–6 kg, talkative and people-centred almost to a fault.
A black shorthair bred in America to look like a miniature panther, with copper eyes.
